intent.proves: At least one user group has at least one active user as a direct member.
intent.scope: direct AccessUserGroupRelation rows from active non-group users to groups; complete enumeration

bindings.reason: The tool answers one subject id at a time; a whole-host count needs a per-subject enumeration handler that is not implemented.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.AccessUserGroupRelationGroupId) FROM AccessUserGroupRelation r JOIN AccessUser g ON g.AccessUserId = r.AccessUserGroupRelationGroupId JOIN AccessUser u ON u.AccessUserId = r.AccessUserGroupRelationUserId WHERE g.AccessUserType = 2 AND u.AccessUserType <> 2 AND u.AccessUserActive = 1
